subject: Pegasus Bank: request for IRP, runbook export and SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@pegasusbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IRP, runbook export and SOC 2 evidence for upcoming audit

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Pegasus Bank is starting a vendor security evidence collection for an internal audit the week of Apr 13. Our auditor asked for the following from Redwood by EOD Apr 12 so we have time to include it in the package:

- Current Incident Response Plan (IRP) and the operational runbook/export used by on-call
- CAIQ / SIG mapping for SOC 2 controls (or pointer to our existing SIG response)
- A one-page executive summary describing incident readiness and recent tabletop outcomes
- A small, redacted sample of telemetry (hashed identifiers ok) and instructions for extracting the same

Can we get confirmation you can deliver these items by EOD Apr 12? If helpful, we’d like a 30-minute walkthrough with your on-call/IR lead to go over the runbook and evidence artifacts (ideally Friday).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom Hargreaves
Head of Vendor Security
Pegasus Bank
Tom.H@pegasusbank.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@pegasusbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IRP, runbook export and SOC 2 evidence for upcoming audit

Hi Tom — thanks for the heads up. We can meet the window and are starting to collect the items now. Proposed plan:

- I’m attaching the current IRP + runbook export (Redwood_IRP_v2.3.pdf) as the baseline.
- We’ll produce a CAIQ/SIG mapping doc and a 1-page exec summary by EOD Apr 12.
- For telemetry: we can provide a hashed sample and a short extraction script/instructions; want to confirm whether hashed identifiers meet your PII policy.
- I’ll schedule a 30-minute walkthrough Friday at 09:30 PDT (30 minutes) — invite attached. If that doesn’t work, propose 11:00 PDT.

Deliverables checklist (what you’ll receive):
- IRP + operational runbook (PDF) – attached
- CAIQ/SIG mapping (spreadsheet) – will share link by EOD
- Telemetry sample + extraction instructions (text file / csv) – will attach
- Executive summary (1 page) – will deliver by EOD Apr 12

Note: the full forensic export (complete logs) requires a formal evidence transfer process — we can provide a redacted/hashed sample for your audit and start a secure transfer request if you need the full set.

I’ll put Marissa and Karthik on the thread for runbook and export questions.

Regards,

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.k@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Redwood_IRP_v2.3.pdf (IRP, 18 pages)

From: Pegasus Bank Security Team <audits@pegasusbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IRP, runbook export and SOC 2 evidence for upcoming audit

Neha — thanks, that sounds good. Friday 09:30 PDT works for our team. A couple of clarifying points:

- For CAIQ/SIG, our auditor requires a mapping with control IDs called out (we can accept a spreadsheet or a shared Drive doc).
- Telemetry: hashed identifiers are acceptable if hashes are irreversible. If possible please include a short note on the hashing method used.
- Exec summary: we need one page that highlights people on-call, escalation path, SLAs for containment, and most recent tabletop date/outcome.

Also, we have a vendor NDA addendum for evidence transfers; I’ve sent a DocuSign link separately (please sign so we can enable the secure SFTP link).

Tom Hargreaves
(on behalf of Pegasus Bank Security Team)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
To: Pegasus Bank Security Team <audits@pegasusbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.b@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IRP, runbook export and SOC 2 evidence for upcoming audit

Tom / Pegasus team — attaching the initial artifacts and a short extraction guide. Summary of what I’m delivering now (attachments + links):

1) Redwood_IRP_v2.3.pdf — our current IRP and on-call runbook (attached). Key changes since v2.2 are captured in the cover note.
2) pegagus_forensic_export_instructions.txt — step-by-step on generating a hashed telemetry sample (SHA-256 salted hashes) and expected CSV columns.
3) telemetry-sample-logs.csv — a 500-line redacted sample (IP hashes, user_id hashes) for auditor review.
4) Drive folder with CAIQ/SIG mapping (link below) — we’ll add the control mapping spreadsheet to that folder by EOD.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cpegasus-audit-pack
DocuSign (NDA addendum): https://www.docusign.com/recipient?doc=abcd-pegasus-nda-addendum

Notes / action items:
- Hashing: we use SHA-256 with a per-audit salt; the instructions file includes the salt rotation policy and sample script.
- For the forensic package: we can stage the full export to your secure SFTP once the NDA addendum is complete. Expect a separate secure-transfer ticket and ETA (24–48 hours after NDA).
- Executive summary: I’ll send a 1-page summary by EOD Apr 12; draft will be shared internally tomorrow morning for review.

Quoted for context:
> On Thu, Apr 9, 2026 at 10:05, Pegasus Bank Security Team <audits@pegasusbank.com> wrote:
>
>  Neha — thanks, that sounds good. Friday 09:30 PDT works for our team...

Attachments: Redwood_IRP_v2.3.pdf (IRP, 18 pages); pegagus_forensic_export_instructions.txt (6 KB); telemetry-sample-logs.csv (sample, 500 rows)

Thanks,

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.b@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IRP, runbook export and SOC 2 evidence for upcoming audit

Quick internal note after a fast pass on the IRP and attachments:

- IRP: suggest one small wording tweak under "containment SLA" (change 4 hours -> 3 hours for high-severity) — I’ll mark the proposed change in the doc.
- Forensic export: I’ll open the secure-transfer ticket and attach the manifest (forensic_manifest_pegasus.txt) that lists the files we’ll stage to SFTP once NDA completes. Expect manifest and ticket ID this afternoon.
- Exec summary: happy to draft the operations bullet for the one-pager; Neha, if you can share the tabletop notes I’ll integrate.

I’ll coordinate the manifest and notify the on-call engineers for the secure export window.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
Attachment: forensic_manifest_pegasus.txt (manifest, 1 KB)
